title: Reasoning or Memorization? Unreliable Results of Reinforcement Learning Due to Data Contamination
authors_zh: Mingqi Wu、Zhihao Zhang、Qiaole Dong、Zhiheng Xi、Jun Zhao、Senjie Jin、Xiaoran Fan、Yuhao Zhou、Huijie Lv、Ming Zhang、Yanwei Fu、Qin Liu、Songyang Zhang、Qi Zhang
paper_type_zh: 程序化算术数据发布与污染审计
best_for_zh: 关注RLVR、程序化验证、基准污染和记忆诊断的研究者
one_line: RandomCalculation releases 20 levels of procedurally generated arithmetic prompt-answer pairs and uses two levels to test whether RLVR gains survive a lower-contamination control.
程序化生成20个算术难度层级，并以正确/随机/反向奖励对照区分低污染RLVR学习与基准记忆。
why: The work joins a reusable construction recipe, a programmatic answer contract, reward-control ablations, and explicit contamination risks, while leaving seeds, exact splits, structural decontamination, and release licensing unresolved.
inclusion_reason: It provides an open procedural arithmetic release and controlled RLVR study for separating reward-aligned learning on a lower-contamination task from apparent gains on familiar benchmarks.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is often evaluated on established mathematical benchmarks. When those benchmarks or closely related solutions may have appeared in pretraining, a post-training gain can mix several effects: learning from the reward, retrieving memorized content, adapting to a response template, or exploiting regularities in the evaluator. The paper asks whether reported gains still appear on a task constructed after the evaluated model releases.

RandomCalculation is the paper's lower-contamination control. Its released data object is a prompt containing a procedurally generated LaTeX arithmetic expression paired with a SymPy-derived numeric answer. It does not contain a gold reasoning trace. The public generator builds 20 subsets indexed by 1-20 recursive binary operations, with 1,000 examples per subset; the RLVR experiments use the 5- and 10-operation subsets.

This design supports a narrower question than "is the model reasoning?" It tests whether a reward signal produces reliable improvement on newly generated answer-verifiable arithmetic under the reported setup. Generation after model release lowers the risk of verbatim item leakage, but does not prove the absence of structurally equivalent expressions, familiar algorithms, or other pretraining influence.

可验证奖励强化学习(RLVR)经常使用既有数学基准评测。如果这些基准或高度相似的解答可能已出现在预训练语料中,那么后训练增益可能混合了多种效应:从奖励中学习、检索记忆内容、适应回答模板,或利用评测器规律。本文关注的是:在评测模型发布之后才构造的任务上,这些增益是否仍然出现。

RandomCalculation 是论文设置的较低污染对照。其公开数据对象是一个包含程序生成 LaTeX 算术表达式的提示,以及由 SymPy 计算的数值答案;数据不含标准推理轨迹。公开生成器按 1 至 20 次递归二元运算构造 20 个子集,每个子集 1,000 条,RLVR 实验只使用其中 5 次和 10 次运算的子集。

该设计回答的问题比"模型是否在推理"更窄:它检验在论文所述设置下,奖励信号能否在新生成、答案可验证的算术任务上带来可靠提升。在模型发布后生成数据可降低题目逐字泄漏风险,但不能证明不存在结构等价表达式、熟悉算法或其他预训练影响。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution has three linked parts.

First, the authors construct RandomCalculation with an open recursive generator. Atomic integers, fractions, squares, and cubes are combined with addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Candidate expressions are parsed and evaluated with latex2sympy2 and SymPy, filtered for real finite results and a float-conversion check, shuffled, and capped at 1,000 items per operation-count level. Direct inspection found no duplicate prompts in the checked-in files, but the public generator does not explicitly deduplicate candidates.

Second, the paper uses behavioral probes on familiar and recent benchmarks. A partial-prompt test supplies the first 60% of a problem and measures exact suffix reconstruction and answer accuracy. It also compares response overlap and KL divergence before and after RL. These measures are treated here as contamination indicators: they can expose suspiciously benchmark-specific behavior, but they do not identify the exact training source.

Third, the RLVR study varies the reward contract. A correct continuous numeric reward is compared with random, inverted, and majority-voted-incorrect rewards. The central comparison is whether correct rewards improve RandomCalculation while spurious rewards fail to do so, and whether this behavior differs from results on familiar benchmarks. The released data, reward ablation, and contamination audit are related evidence streams; none alone establishes data quality or general reasoning.

本文贡献由三个相互关联的部分组成。

第一,作者使用公开递归生成器构造 RandomCalculation。生成器把整数、分数、平方和立方等原子项通过加、减、乘、除组合成表达式,再用 latex2sympy2 和 SymPy 解析与求值,筛除非实数或非有限结果并执行一次浮点转换检查,随后打乱,并将每个运算次数层级限制为 1,000 条。直接检查未在已提交文件中发现重复 prompt,但公开生成器没有显式去重步骤。

第二,论文在熟悉基准和较新基准上使用行为探针。部分提示测试仅给出题目前 60%,测量后缀精确重构率与答案正确率;论文还比较强化学习前后的回答重合度和 KL 散度。这里应把这些量视为污染指示器:它们可以揭示可疑的基准特定行为,但不能定位确切训练来源。

第三,RLVR 实验改变奖励契约,将正确的连续数值奖励与随机、反向和多数投票错误奖励对比。关键比较是:正确奖励能否提升 RandomCalculation 表现,而伪奖励是否不能稳定提升,以及这种现象是否不同于熟悉基准上的结果。公开数据、奖励消融和污染审计是相关但独立的证据流;任何一项都不能单独证明数据质量或通用推理能力。

title: Method
方法
html:
The generator recursively builds expression trees with 1-20 binary operations. The paper describes bounded integer, fraction, square, and cube leaves and the four basic arithmetic operators. The implementation converts each LaTeX expression through latex2sympy2, evaluates it numerically with SymPy, rejects non-real or non-finite values, applies a nominal 0.001 float-conversion check, shuffles, and keeps up to 1,000 items for each level. Because both operands in that check are converted to float, it is not a comparison against a retained high-precision reference. The checked-in data has no duplicate prompts, but the generator does not implement explicit deduplication.

The checked-in JSON records expose id, prompt, and answer. Files 01_op_list.json through 20_op_list.json each contain 1,000 rows for the paper's 20 levels; the directory also contains a 1,000-row 00_op_list.json of base expressions. Operation level is represented by file organization rather than a released per-record derivation tree. IDs reflect enumeration before filtering and therefore have gaps in several files. A seed is not fixed, so regeneration is a recipe reproduction rather than an exact reconstruction of the checked-in files.

For RLVR, the paper selects the 5- and 10-operation subsets and reports a 700/300 train/validation division for each. Exact split membership is not released. The main model is Qwen2.5-Math-7B, with Llama3.1-8B-Instruct used as a comparison. Reported training uses GRPO in a TTRL-style setup, learning rate 5e-7, batch size 128, temperature 1.0, and 16 sampled responses per prompt. The Avg@16 evaluation reference instead uses temperature 0.7, top-p 0.8, and top-k 20; these decoding settings should not be conflated with training.

The correct reward is continuous in [0,1] and uses absolute and relative numeric error, avoiding an almost-everywhere-zero exact-match signal. Controls replace it with random, inverted, or majority-voted-incorrect feedback. Because the contract observes the final numeric answer, it does not validate the semantic correctness of an intermediate rationale.

生成器递归构建包含 1 至 20 次二元运算的表达式树。论文描述了有界整数、分数、平方和立方叶节点,以及四则运算符。实现先通过 latex2sympy2 转换 LaTeX 表达式,再用 SymPy 做数值求值,剔除非实数或非有限结果,执行名义上的 0.001 浮点转换检查,然后打乱并保留每层最多 1,000 条。由于该检查的两个操作数都被转换为 float,它没有保留高精度参考值用于比较。已提交数据没有重复 prompt,但生成器没有实现显式去重。

公开 JSON 记录包含 id、prompt 和 answer。01_op_list.json 至 20_op_list.json 对应论文的 20 个层级,每个文件 1,000 条;目录还包含一个有 1,000 条基础表达式的 00_op_list.json。运算层级由文件组织表示,发布记录不含逐样本推导树。多个文件的 ID 因过滤发生跳号,说明它们是过滤前枚举位置而非连续行号。生成器未固定随机种子,因此重新运行只能复现构造配方,不能精确还原仓库中的文件。

RLVR 实验选择 5 次和 10 次运算子集,并报告各自按 700/300 划分训练集与验证集,但没有公开具体划分成员。主模型为 Qwen2.5-Math-7B,Llama3.1-8B-Instruct 用于对比。论文报告的训练采用 TTRL 风格设置下的 GRPO,学习率 5e-7、批大小 128、温度 1.0,每个提示采样 16 个回答。作为评测参照的 Avg@16 则使用温度 0.7、top-p 0.8 和 top-k 20;两套解码设置不能混为一谈。

正确奖励位于 [0,1],同时依据绝对误差和相对误差,从而避免严格精确匹配几乎处处为零的问题。对照条件把奖励替换为随机、反向或多数投票错误反馈。由于该契约只观察最终数值答案,它不能验证中间推理文本在语义上是否正确。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest evidence for the data artifact is direct: the author repository publishes both the generator and generated RandomCalculation JSON files, while the official AAAI paper specifies the construction and experimental role. Inspection of commit 074a6e7e41bccbc029f7f4a4ae4b458034aa4b5b found 21 result files: a 0-operation base file and twenty 1-20-operation files, all with 1,000 id/prompt/answer rows and no duplicate prompts within a file. This supports the existence of an open procedural prompt-answer release. It does not establish exact regeneration because the release lacks a fixed seed, explicit deduplication, and an immutable version tag.

The paper's partial-prompt probe reports a marked benchmark contrast for Qwen2.5-Math-7B. Given the first 60% of a prompt, exact suffix reconstruction is 54.60% and answer accuracy is 53.6% on MATH-500, versus 0% and 2.0% on LiveMathBench v202505. For Llama3.1-8B-Instruct, the corresponding figures are 3.8% and 2.4% on MATH-500, and 0% and 1.0% on LiveMathBench. These results are consistent with model- and benchmark-specific exposure, but they do not recover a pretraining corpus or prove item provenance.

On RandomCalculation, correct rewards produce sustained improvement for Qwen2.5-Math-7B, whereas random and inverted rewards are unstable or collapse. The 5-operation setting can exceed the paper's Max@16 reference; gains are smaller at 10 operations. Llama3.1-8B-Instruct does not exceed Max@16 even with correct rewards. The paper also reports greater pre/post-RL response similarity and lower KL divergence on familiar MATH items than on RandomCalculation, which is suggestive of retrieval or constrained adaptation.

These are results about a particular reward-training experiment, not proofs that RandomCalculation is intrinsically high-quality. The paper does not report human error analysis, derivation validation, structural collision testing, or a calibrated mapping from operation count to reasoning difficulty.

对数据工件最直接的证据来自公开发布:作者仓库同时提供 RandomCalculation 生成器和生成后的 JSON 文件,AAAI 正式论文则说明了构造方法及其在实验中的作用。对提交 074a6e7e41bccbc029f7f4a4ae4b458034aa4b5b 的检查发现 21 个结果文件:一个 0 次运算基础文件和二十个 1 至 20 次运算文件;每个文件都有 1,000 条 id/prompt/answer 记录,文件内未发现重复 prompt。这证明存在一个开放的程序化提示—答案数据发布,但由于缺少固定随机种子、显式去重和不可变版本标签,不能证明能够精确重生成相同文件。

论文的部分提示探针显示 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 在不同基准上有显著差异。仅给出题目前 60% 时,MATH-500 的后缀精确重构率为 54.60%,答案正确率为 53.6%;LiveMathBench v202505 则分别为 0% 和 2.0%。Llama3.1-8B-Instruct 在 MATH-500 上对应为 3.8% 和 2.4%,在 LiveMathBench 上为 0% 和 1.0%。这些结果与模型和基准特定的暴露相符,但不能还原预训练语料,也不能证明题目来源。

在 RandomCalculation 上,正确奖励使 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 持续提升,而随机和反向奖励表现不稳定或发生退化;5 次运算设置可超过论文的 Max@16 参照,10 次运算上的增益较小。Llama3.1-8B-Instruct 即使使用正确奖励也未超过 Max@16。论文还报告,熟悉的 MATH 题目在强化学习前后具有更高回答相似度和更低 KL 散度,相比 RandomCalculation 更像检索或受约束适应。

这些是特定奖励训练实验的结果,不是 RandomCalculation 内在数据质量的证明。论文未报告人工错误分析、推导过程验证、结构碰撞测试,也未校准运算次数与推理难度之间的映射。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The distinctive element is not procedural arithmetic generation by itself. The paper couples a post-release, programmatically checkable data construction with reward ablations and contamination-oriented behavioral probes. This makes the procedural data serve as an experimental control: apparent RLVR improvement on familiar benchmarks is compared with learning behavior on newly sampled arithmetic under correct and deliberately corrupted feedback.

The release is also useful as a compact audit case. The prompt-answer object, generator, numerical terminal predicate, and reward variants are inspectable, while missing seeds, split identities, derivation trees, and release licensing remain visible rather than being hidden behind an aggregate benchmark score.

Several components are established techniques rather than novel claims: recursive expression generation, SymPy-based answer computation, GRPO/TTRL-style training, partial-prompt completion, and response-distribution comparisons. The contribution is their integration into a controlled test of whether an RLVR result is compatible with reward-driven learning or may be inflated by benchmark familiarity.

本文的特点并不只是程序化生成算术题,而是把模型发布后的可程序验证数据构造、奖励消融和面向污染的行为探针结合起来。程序化数据由此成为实验对照:熟悉基准上的表面 RLVR 增益,可以与模型在新采样算术题上、面对正确或故意破坏的反馈时的学习行为进行比较。

该发布也构成一个紧凑的审计案例。提示—答案对象、生成器、数值终止判据和多种奖励条件都可检查;与此同时,随机种子、具体划分、推导树和发布许可证等缺失项仍然清晰可见,而不是被总体基准分数遮蔽。

其中多项组成技术本身并非新方法,包括递归表达式生成、基于 SymPy 的答案计算、GRPO/TTRL 风格训练、部分提示补全以及回答分布比较。贡献主要在于将它们整合成一个受控检验,用于判断 RLVR 结果是否符合奖励驱动学习,或可能被基准熟悉度放大。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The release is reproducible at the recipe level, not byte-for-byte. The generator does not fix a random seed or explicitly deduplicate candidates, the repository has no tagged immutable release, and the reported 700/300 memberships for the 5- and 10-operation RLVR subsets are not published. Although direct inspection found no duplicate prompt within any checked-in result file, that property is not guaranteed by the released procedure. Neither the repository nor dataset declares a license.

The data schema is thin. Records expose prompts and final answers but no expression AST, sampled atom/operator provenance, exact symbolic value, derivation trace, verifier log, or per-item difficulty evidence. Operation count measures recursive syntax, not necessarily conceptual difficulty; cancellation, repeated subexpressions, number magnitude, and numerical conditioning can make examples with the same count differ substantially.

The verifier inherits parser and numerical assumptions. latex2sympy2 conversion, SymPy evaluation, and float serialization can create precision or representation edge cases. In the generator's nominal 0.001 check, both the answer string and SymPy value are converted to float, so it does not compare the serialized value with a preserved arbitrary-precision reference. The continuous reward likewise checks answer proximity; neither mechanism establishes that a generated rationale is valid.

"Generated after model release" is a useful temporal control, not a guarantee of zero contamination. Models may have seen equivalent structures, learned the underlying algorithms, or adapted to benchmark templates. Partial-prompt reconstruction, answer recovery, response overlap, and KL divergence are behavioral indicators with alternative explanations; they do not identify exact training records or causally isolate memorization.

The experimental conclusions are bounded by two model families, two RandomCalculation levels for RLVR, a specific optimizer and reward design, and arithmetic expressions rather than broader mathematical reasoning. The official repository exposes generation and evaluation code but no complete RL training implementation or exact split manifest. The reported downstream scores and training curves should therefore not be used as standalone evidence of dataset quality or end-to-end reproducibility.

该发布只能在配方层面复现,不能逐字节复现。生成器未固定随机种子,也没有显式去重候选;仓库没有带标签的不可变版本,5 次和 10 次运算 RLVR 子集所报告的 700/300 具体成员也未发布。直接检查虽然没有在任何已提交结果文件内发现重复 prompt,但发布程序并不保证这一性质。仓库和数据集均未声明许可证。

数据模式较薄。记录提供提示和最终答案,但不含表达式 AST、原子与运算符采样来源、精确符号值、推导轨迹、验证日志或逐题难度证据。运算次数衡量的是递归语法,而不必然等于概念难度;约分消去、重复子表达式、数值大小和数值条件性都会使相同运算次数的样本差异很大。

验证器继承了解析和数值假设。latex2sympy2 转换、SymPy 求值与浮点序列化都可能引入精度或表示边界问题。生成器名义上的 0.001 检查把答案字符串和 SymPy 值都转换为 float,因此没有把序列化值与保留的任意精度参考作比较。连续奖励同样只检查回答接近程度;两者都不能证明模型生成的推理文本有效。

"在模型发布后生成"是有价值的时间对照,但不等于零污染保证。模型可能见过结构等价题目、学会底层算法,或适应了基准模板。部分提示重构、答案恢复、回答重合度和 KL 散度都是存在其他解释的行为指标,不能定位确切训练记录,也不能因果隔离记忆效应。

实验结论还受限于两个模型家族、仅两个用于 RLVR 的 RandomCalculation 层级、特定优化器与奖励设计,以及算术表达式而非更广泛的数学推理。官方仓库公开了生成和评测代码,但没有完整 RL 训练实现或精确划分清单。因而,论文报告的下游分数和训练曲线不能单独作为数据质量或端到端可复现性的证据。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Within the data_construction_open_release_recipes track, this card is valuable as both a reusable generator pattern and a warning about evaluation design. A practitioner can adapt the recursive construction, symbolic/numeric checking, and reward controls to create fresh answer-verifiable tasks for RLVR smoke tests, curriculum studies, verifier calibration, or contamination-sensitive evaluation.

A stronger derivative release should preserve the expression AST and exact symbolic answer, record generator version and random seed, attach stable item hashes, publish train/validation membership, document numeric precision and parser versions, retain verifier outcomes, and declare a reuse license. Difficulty should be characterized with more than operation count, for example tree depth, operand magnitude, operator composition, cancellation rate, and baseline solve rates.

For atlas use, the paper demonstrates why three objects must remain separate: the released data artifact, the feedback/verifier contract, and the downstream RL result. The generator and data files support an open construction recipe; the continuous reward defines answer-level supervision; the reported model gains only evaluate one training setup. Reusing this card responsibly means auditing each object independently and keeping unresolved provenance, structural-equivalence, and reproducibility questions explicit.

在 data_construction_open_release_recipes 轨道中,本卡既提供可复用的生成器范式,也提醒评测设计中的污染风险。实践者可以改造其递归构造、符号/数值检查和奖励对照,用于创建新的答案可验证任务,支持 RLVR 冒烟测试、课程学习、验证器校准或污染敏感评测。

更完善的衍生发布应保留表达式 AST 和精确符号答案,记录生成器版本与随机种子,附加稳定样本哈希,公开训练/验证成员,说明数值精度和解析器版本,保存验证器结果,并声明复用许可证。难度刻画也应超越运算次数,例如加入树深、操作数规模、运算符组成、消去比例和基线求解率。

对于图谱整理,这篇论文说明必须区分三个对象:公开数据工件、反馈/验证器契约和下游强化学习结果。生成器与数据文件支持开放构造配方;连续奖励定义答案级监督;模型增益只评估一种训练设置。负责任地复用本卡,需要分别审计三个对象,并明确保留来源、结构等价性和可复现性方面的未决问题。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Treat RandomCalculation as a lower-contamination procedural control, not as a certified contamination-free dataset.
  • Keep decoding configurations distinct: reported RLVR training uses temperature 1.0 and 16 samples per prompt, while Avg@16 evaluation uses temperature 0.7, top-p 0.8, and top-k 20.
  • The released supervision is answer-level. No gold rationale or per-step verifier signal is provided.
  • The result directory has an auxiliary 0-operation file plus the twenty advertised 1-20-operation files; all checked files have 1,000 rows, but the generator does not explicitly deduplicate.
  • Partial-prompt and KL/overlap results support an audit hypothesis but do not reveal exact pretraining provenance.
  • Before reuse, pin a commit, add a seed and split manifest, implement explicit deduplication, inspect the float-conversion check and other numeric edge cases, and resolve the absent license.

• 应把 RandomCalculation 视为较低污染的程序化对照,而不是经过认证的无污染数据集。
  • 需要区分解码配置:论文报告的 RLVR 训练使用温度 1.0、每个提示 16 个样本;Avg@16 评测使用温度 0.7、top-p 0.8 和 top-k 20。
  • 公开监督是答案级的,不含标准推理轨迹或逐步验证器信号。
  • 结果目录除论文所述 1 至 20 次运算的二十个文件外,还包含一个 0 次运算辅助文件;本次检查的所有文件均有 1,000 条,但生成器没有显式去重。
  • 部分提示以及 KL 散度/重合度结果支持审计假设,但不能揭示确切预训练来源。
  • 复用前应固定提交版本,补充随机种子与划分清单,实现显式去重,检查浮点转换条件及其他数值边界情况,并解决许可证缺失问题。

title: Citation
引用
html:

value.html: Construction after the evaluated model releases reduces exact temporal leakage risk. The paper does not report a corpus-level collision or structural-equivalence scan, so the procedure does not establish that every expression pattern is absent from pretraining.

items: No random seed is fixed, so rerunning the generator need not reproduce the checked-in files exactly
The paper describes unique problems and the checked-in files have no duplicate prompts, but the released generator does not explicitly deduplicate candidates
The implementation's 0.001 check converts both the serialized answer and SymPy result to float, so it does not preserve a high-precision reference for comparison
Operation count is a syntax-tree measure and is not calibrated as human or model reasoning difficulty
SymPy numerical evaluation, LaTeX parsing, and float serialization can introduce representation or precision effects
Post-release generation limits verbatim leakage but does not rule out structurally equivalent examples or learned arithmetic algorithms
The paper documents 700/300 RLVR splits, but the public release does not identify their exact membership
Partial-prompt reconstruction, answer recovery, response overlap, and KL divergence are behavioral contamination indicators, not provenance proof
No gold derivation is released, so the numeric verifier checks final answers rather than reasoning validity

论文描述唯一问题且已检入文件无重复提示，但已发布生成器不显式对候选去重
实现的 0.001 检查将序列化答案与 SymPy 结果均转换为 float，故不保留用于比较的高精度参考
运算计数是语法树度量，未校准为人类或模型推理难度
SymPy 数值求值、LaTeX 解析与 float 序列化可引入表示或精度效应
发布后生成限制逐字泄漏，但不排除结构等价示例或已学算术算法
论文记录 700/300 RLVR 划分，但公开发布未标识其确切成员资格
部分提示重建、答案恢复、响应重叠与 KL 散度是行为污染指标，而非出处证明
未发布黄金推导，故数值验证器检查最终答案而非推理有效性
